name: Col d'Èze Loop
description: Nice's daily climb: 44 km over the Col d'Èze and the Corniche roads — the warm-up ride that happens to have some of the best views in cycling.

name: Menton via Col de la Madone
description: 88 km along the coast to Menton and back over the Col de la Madone — professional cycling's most famous test climb.

name: Col de la Madone and Grande Corniche Loop
description: The full Madone day: 101 km and 2,400 m combining the test climb with the Grande Corniche balcony road above the Mediterranean.

name: Col de Vence and Bouyon Loop
description: 94 km northwest of the city over the Col de Vence to Bouyon — the standard structured-training loop on quiet middle-mountain roads.

name: Col de Turini and Col de Braus Loop
description: The epic: 132 km and almost 3,500 m over the Col de Braus and the mighty Col de Turini of Monte Carlo Rally and Tour de France fame.

name: Villefranche, Èze and Cap Ferrat
description: The short classic: 32 km around Villefranche, up to Èze village and around the Cap Ferrat peninsula — small distance, big views.

name: Cap d'Ail, Madone and Èze
description: 62 km from Cap d'Ail combining the Col de la Madone with Èze — a condensed hit of the area's two most famous climbs.

name: Madone d'Utelle Loop
description: 110 km and 2,500 m from Nice up the Var valley to the sanctuary summit of the Madone d'Utelle — a dead-end climb with the best view on the Côte d'Azur.
